title: Infrastructure and Storage System Engineer
description:
Project description

Our Client is one of the largest TV providers in North America. We are looking for VMWare Administrator to maintain security, performance monitoring, Installing, configuring, securing, managing, and monitoring VMware vSphere ESXi clusters in multiple data centers.


Responsibilities

- Installation, configuration, maintenance, tuning and troubleshooting of VMware environment running on vSphere 6.5, 6.7, 7, 8.

Installation of ESXi Host and vCenter Server

Upgrading ESXi

Responsible for ESXI Host Server Health Check and Performance Monitoring

Experience working with VCF, vCenter, vSphere, vROPs - Upgrade VM Tools and VM Hardware versions - Monitor and remediate security compliance results from tool like Nessus/Tenable - Perform VMware crash/error analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Coordinate Post Problem Analysis and Trend Analysis - Basic Linux administration

On-call support


Skills

Must have

Operating System Proficiency, including Linux (primarily RHEL and Rocky)

Server Hardware Management

Virtualization, especially VMware

Network Management, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP

Security, including best practices, patch management, and vulnerability assessments

Monitoring and Troubleshooting


Languages

English: C1 Advanced

title: Data Analyst | Ecommerce (Full-time Remote, BR)
description:
About Us:

Carepod is a premium humidifier brand operating in the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re growing fast and building a data-driven culture where insights actually shape decisions.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst who thinks like a business partner, not just a report builder.


What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain dashboards & projection tools such as sales, marketing, inventory, etc.
  • Analyze ecommerce & marketing data (Shopify, ads, reviews)
  • Identify trends in conversion, retention, and customer behavior
  • Support leadership with clear insights and recommendations
  • Answer real business questions, fast


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years experience as a Data Analyst
  • Strong SQL + Excel / Google Sheets
  • Experience with dashboards & KPIs
  • Exeprience with AI Automations such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, n8n, Make, Airtable, etc.
  • Ecommerce or DTC experience preferred
  • Comfortable communicating insights in English
  • Bonus: Python, BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)


Why Carepod

  • Direct exposure to leadership
  • Real impact on decisions
  • International business experience
  • Fully remote, long-term opportunity


What We Offer:

 • Fully remote work environment

 • Competitive salary

 • Flexible PTO policy

 • Opportunity to grow with a scaling e-commerce brand

 • A supportive, collaborative, and agile team culture


⸻


To Apply:

  • Send your resume and a short note about why you’re a great fit

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Azure Data Engineer
description:
We are currently looking for a Portuguese speaking Data Engineer to work across Microsoft Azure solutions in delivering proactive services and workshops to premier enterprise customers in remotely in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement end-to-end data architecture solutions on Microsoft Azure.

title: AI Engineer (NLP)
description:
We're looking for a Senior ML/AI Engineer to own and evolve our LLM-powered user experience. You'll work directly with our technical co-founder to build, optimize, and monitor agent systems that parse workout descriptions, provide scaling recommendations, and enable conversational data retrieval - all with production-grade accuracy and speed.

This is a hands-on role focused on the ML/AI engineering side: prompt engineering, model optimization, agent orchestration, and continuous improvement based on real-world usage patterns.

What You’ll Do

Core Responsibilities

  • Own the workout parsing system: improve accuracy of our fine-tuned model (currently Qwen-based) that converts natural language workout descriptions into structured schemas
  • Design and implement agent workflows for workout scaling recommendations and performance tracking
  • Build observability workflows using Langfuse to identify and systematically address model performance issues
  • Optimize agent response latency while maintaining accuracy across our tool-based reasoning system
  • Collaborate on agent architecture decisions, including potential migration to frameworks like DSPy
  • Ship production features: workout entry system, scaling recommendations, and score reporting

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years of ML/AI engineering experience with at least 2 years working with LLMs in production
  • Strong prompt engineering and model optimization skills
  • Experience building and deploying agent systems with tools/functions
  • Proven ability to use observability platforms to diagnose and improve model performance
  • Experience with model fine-tuning (any framework/approach)
  • Strong Python programming skills
  • Active CrossFit participant - candidates should understand standard movements and workout structures

Strongly Preferred:

  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (DSPy, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Background in production ML operations and monitoring
  • Experience with Modal.com or similar serverless ML platforms
  • Track record of iteratively improving LLM systems based on user feedback and metrics
  • Experience fine tuning similar open-source LLMs

Success in First 6 Months

  • Ship workout entry system with improved parsing accuracy
  • Launch basic workout scaling recommendations
  • Implement user score reporting and retrieval
  • Establish robust monitoring workflows to catch and address model failures and poor user experiences
  • Contribute to agent architecture decisions as we scale

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP Fiori
description:
Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori

Local: 100% remoto

Regime: PJ ou Coop

Nível: Sênior


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori para atuar em projetos estratégicos de modernização e evolução tecnológica no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) .

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções modernas utilizando ABAP Cloud e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 , aplicando boas práticas de clean core e arquitetura extensível.

Além das iniciativas mais modernas, é importante que o profissional possua base sólida em ABAP Clássico , garantindo flexibilidade para atuar em demandas tradicionais quando necessário.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e extensões com ABAP Cloud / RAP integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 .
  • Implementar e manter serviços OData, CDS Views e AMDPs para consumo em interfaces Fiori.
  • Trabalhar em ambiente SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP , aplicando conceitos de clean core e extensibilidade .
  • Apoiar arquitetos e consultores funcionais na definição e entrega de soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir performance, segurança e qualidade de código nas entregas.
  • Contribuir com revisões de código, boas práticas e mentoria técnica para o time.
  • Atuar também, quando necessário, em demandas ABAP Clássico , mantendo soluções legadas e promovendo sua evolução gradativa para o novo modelo.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 5+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento ABAP , com domínio de ABAP Clássico e ABAP Cloud .
  • Experiência sólida com RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) .
  • Domínio de SAP Fiori / SAP UI5 e Fiori Elements .
  • Conhecimento em CDS Views , OData Services , AMDPs e integrações RESTful .
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA e ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento (Eclipse ADT, Git, transportes em BTP ).
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho colaborativo em times ágeis.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) .
  • Experiência com SAP BTP , extensões side-by-side e integrações em nuvem.
  • Certificação SAP ABAP for Cloud ou SAP BTP.
  • Experiência em S/4HANA Cloud (Public ou Private Edition) .

description:
A ProDoctor está crescendo e você pode fazer parte deste sucesso!

Abrimos mais uma vaga: desta vez, a oportunidade é no setor de Suporte. Como Analista de Suporte Júnior, você será responsável por realizar o atendimento a usuários de forma consultiva e eficiente.


Você deverá proporcionar ao cliente uma experiência eficaz e objetiva na resolução de problemas.


Suas responsabilidades incluem:

  • Identificar e registrar problemas e solicitações de suporte, sejam eles via e-mail, chat ou telefone.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados  - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
  • Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Data Management Analyst
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

We are looking for Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team. This role is fully remote in Brazil (CLT) and offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment supporting critical data processes.


We are seeking Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team in fully remote positions based in Brazil (CLT). This role supports critical data processes and requires strong attention to detail, accuracy, and collaboration across multiple teams.


While all coordinators will work within MDM processes, there are two distinct specializations :

  • Credit & Contract Administration – Responsible for managing the contract lifecycle, reviewing documentation for accuracy, performing credit checks, and ensuring proper data entry across multiple platforms.
  • Location & Administrative Maintenance – Focused on maintaining location data integrity, including new setups, updates, closures, and supporting special projects related to merchant and location administration.


Both specializations play a key role in supporting operational excellence and require the ability to meet deadlines while delivering high-quality results.


Responsibilities

  • Process assignments within standard timelines (2 business days)
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of data in MDM systems
  • Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, and Finance teams
  • Track and report data metrics for compliance and performance


Credit & Contract Administration:

  • Review incoming contract documentation for discrepancies
  • Perform credit checks in accordance with company policy
  • Enter approved contracts into multiple systems
  • Maintain merchant documentation and follow up on pending agreements


Location & Administrative Maintenance:

  • Set up new locations and update existing records in MDM
  • Manage location name changes, moves, closures, and inactivations
  • Support special projects assigned by the Data Administration Team


Requirements

  • College degree preferred (not required)
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP and report comparison functions) for MDM profile
  • Administrative experience and ORACLE knowledge for contract profile
  • Ability to learn quickly and work well in a team
  • Credit review experience is a plus


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to manage repetitive tasks efficiently
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills


Benefits

Monthly internet/mobile allowance

️ Meal and food vouchers

Annual bonus

Health and dental plan

  • Credit & Contract Administration – Responsible for managing the contract lifecycle, reviewing documentation for accuracy, performing credit checks, and ensuring proper data entry across multiple platforms.

Both specializations play a key role in supporting operational excellence and require the ability to meet deadlines while delivering high-quality results.

  • Process assignments within standard timelines (2 business days)

  • Perform credit checks in accordance with company policy
  • Enter approved contracts into multiple systems
  • Maintain merchant documentation and follow up on pending agreements


Location & Administrative Maintenance:

  • Set up new locations and update existing records in MDM
  • Manage location name changes, moves, closures, and inactivations
  • Support special projects assigned by the Data Administration Team


Requirements

  • College degree preferred (not required)
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP and report comparison functions) for MDM profile

  • Credit review experience is a plus


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to manage repetitive tasks efficiently
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills


Benefits

Monthly internet/mobile allowance

️ Meal and food vouchers

Annual bonus

Health and dental plan

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Frontend
description:
Ser referência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de funcionalidades de software , de modo que não apenas agregue valor ao produto como também oriente e capacite o time de desenvolvimento, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a evolução técnica do time de desenvolvimento do produto de atuação. Especialidade em Frontend.

Conhecimentos Específicos Desejáveis:

- Lógica de Programação;

- Arquitetura de Software (noções);

- APIs REST;

- Banco de Dados SQL Relacionais e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalente)(Opcional);

- Testes Automatizados (JUnit, Jest, Karma ou equivalentes);

- DevOps (CI/CD, Docker, Git/GitFlow, GitLab, Jenkins ou similar) (opcional);

- Feature Flags e estratégias de deploy (opcional);

- Cache (Redis) (Opcional);

- Copilot ou equivalente (opcional)

- Provedores de Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure, equivalentes)(pelo menos 1)

- Design Patterns (opcional)

- Segurança no desenvolvimento (DevSecOps, outros)

- Angular (incluindo Angular 18+)

- Typescript (tipagem estática e POO)

- Javascript avançado(opcional)

- HTML e CSS

- Node.js básico (para ferramentas de build e execução de apps)

- React ou Vue (opcional)

- Experiência em otimização de performance em grandes aplicações front-end (opcional)

- Experiência em A11y (acessibilidade) (opcional)

- Integração com mensageria em tempo real (WebSockets, Pub/Sub)(opcional)

- Métodos ágeis

title: Acelerador de Agilidade - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, permitindo que nossos parceiros foquem em seus principais pontos fortes enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics.

Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:

Acelerador de Agilidade - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você:

  • Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares
  • Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares
  • Cartão flex (alimentação e refeição)
  • Auxílio home office para vaga remota
  • Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas
  • Auxílio creche
  • Seguro de vida
  • Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial
  • Parceria com instituições de ensino
  • Parceria com escolas de idiomas
  • Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês
  • Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas
  • Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e licença paternidade de 20 dias
  • Treinamento completo como parte de um processo de indução robusto, com acesso às plataformas NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy (80.000+ cursos)
  • GetVibes , nosso programa de escuta ativa, que promove ações contínuas de melhoria a partir do feedback dos colegas


O que esperar desta posição:

Você atuará como facilitador(a) e agente de transformação ágil em times multidisciplinares, apoiando a evolução da maturidade ágil, a melhoria contínua e a entrega de valor em ambientes de alta complexidade tecnológica.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência em times ágeis de desenvolvimento, testes, suporte, infraestrutura e manutenção
  • Atuação em ágeis convencionais e ágeis escalados
  • Domínio de Scrum, Kanban e SAFe
  • Experiência na facilitação de cerimônias ágeis e rituais de planejamento e acompanhamento
  • Capacidade de orientar times, remover impedimentos e promover padrões ágeis
  • Vivência com métricas ágeis, indicadores de qualidade e performance
  • Apoio a iniciativas de CI/CD e práticas de engenharia que sustentem entregas contínuas
  • Capacidade de apoiar ações estratégicas, induzindo a evolução e melhoria contínua


Desejáveis:

  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KMP, SAFe, ICP-ACC, entre outras)
  • Experiência em ambientes de transformação ágil em larga escala
  • Atuação como Agile Coach ou referência de maturidade ágil


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo.

Se tiver qualquer dúvida sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics ou sobre o processo seletivo, não hesite em entrar em contato com nosso time de RH pelo e-mail: .

  • Treinamento completo como parte de um processo de indução robusto, com acesso às plataformas NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy (80.000+ cursos)

Você atuará como facilitador(a) e agente de transformação ágil em times multidisciplinares, apoiando a evolução da maturidade ágil, a melhoria contínua e a entrega de valor em ambientes de alta complexidade tecnológica.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência em times ágeis de desenvolvimento, testes, suporte, infraestrutura e manutenção
  • Atuação em ágeis convencionais e ágeis escalados
  • Domínio de Scrum, Kanban e SAFe
  • Experiência na facilitação de cerimônias ágeis e rituais de planejamento e acompanhamento
  • Capacidade de orientar times, remover impedimentos e promover padrões ágeis
  • Vivência com métricas ágeis, indicadores de qualidade e performance
  • Apoio a iniciativas de CI/CD e práticas de engenharia que sustentem entregas contínuas
  • Capacidade de apoiar ações estratégicas, induzindo a evolução e melhoria contínua


Desejáveis:

  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KMP, SAFe, ICP-ACC, entre outras)

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Handling major incidents via CIRS (Critical Issue Response System) and providing frequent updates until resolution.
  • Performing deep-dive application troubleshooting and identifying preventive actions.
  • Managing CIRS-related requests including deployments, feature toggles, and data fixes.
  • Following up on major production incidents and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
  • Enhancing monitoring capabilities using tools like Dynatrace, Kibana, and Splunk .
  • Writing and improving monitoring scripts and alerts based on incident learnings.
  • Handling customer escalations and coordinating with Support & Engineering teams.
  • Supporting planned activities and responding to ad-hoc requests from CES teams.


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Deep experience in DevOps and Production Support .
  • Experience in automation and CI/CD practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Kibana, Splunk .
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to deep dive into application issues.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills across teams.


Please submit resumé in English.

title: Technical Lead Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Technical Lead Developer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

kills: B2B domain expertise, Salesforce, strong communication, process improvement

JD:

  • Act as the primary SPOC , coordinating resources and managing priorities across teams.
  • Drive service reviews, escalate issues, and ensure timely resolution for critical business processes.
  • Suggest and implement process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and governance.
  • Analyze KPIs and reporting metrics to identify trends and recommend corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align technology solutions with business objectives and compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Expertise in Salesforce Configurations using Workflows, Process builders, Flows, Roles, Enterprise Territory Management, Security Controls, Reports and Dashboards and Sharing rules.
  • Experience in Administration, Configuration, Implementation and experience with Salesforce platform.
  • Experience in Salesforce Customization, Security Access, Workflow Approvals, Data Validation, data utilities.
  • Expertise in SFDC Development using Apex Language, Visual Force pages, Classes, Controllers, Triggers, Indexes, Web Services, Components, Tabs, Apex Web services, Custom Objects, Reports, Analytic Snapshots and Dashboards, Profiles, Creating Roles, Page Layouts, Org - Wide default, Sharing rules, Work Flows
  • Experience in Sales Cloud, Field Service and CPQ, Ant Migration tool, Standard and custom controllers, Data Loader, Force.com, Eclipse IDE Plug-in, VS Code, Work Flow-Approval, Custom objects, Custom tabs, Email service, Html, Web-service (REST and SOAP)
  • Experience in debugging the code for troubleshooting the issues


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: DevOps Engineer with AWS - Relocation from Brasil to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Technical or Bachelor’s Degree in IT-related areas (at least level 5 or 6);
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in IT areas (Infrastructure, Software Development, Systems Administration);
  • At least 3 years of professional experience working as a DevOps Engineer (mandatory);
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience working with AWS cloud environment (e.g. EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, CloudWatch, EKS/ECS, and Lambda);
  • Experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar;
  • Experience with CI/CD and Automation such as Jenkins, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet (valued);
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Professional experience with programming and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java, Bash, Shell, or similar);
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools;
  • English proficiency (at least B2 in conversation – mandatory);
  • Availability for relocation from Brasil to Portugal (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;

title: Platform Engineer / DevOps Engineer SR
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Buscamos um(a) Platform Engineer / DevOps Engineer SR para atuar na construção e evolução de serviços de infraestrutura de plataforma, adotando práticas modernas de automação, observabilidade e infraestrutura como produto, suportando times de desenvolvimento com ambientes escaláveis, seguros e resilientes.


Atuação para um cliente sediado em Portugal


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter serviços de infraestrutura de plataforma baseados em containers e Kubernetes;
  • Projetar e implementar serviços de infraestrutura como produtos reutilizáveis;
  • Automatizar o ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento e operação da infraestrutura;
  • Implementar e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD e práticas GitOps;
  • Trabalhar com provedores de nuvem, especialmente Azure ou GCP;
  • Implementar e manter soluções de monitoramento e observabilidade (Grafana, Prometheus);
  • Aplicar práticas de Infrastructure as Code (IaC) utilizando Terraform, Crossplane ou ferramentas similares;
  • Atuar em ambientes Linux, redes, TCP/IP e serviços de segurança;
  • Colaborar de forma próxima com times de produto e desenvolvimento.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação remota no fuso horário de Portugal


Requisitos

  • Experiência prática com Kubernetes (certificação CKA ou OpenShift obrigatória);
  • Experiência com CI/CD e GitOps (GitHub Actions, Argo CD ou similares);
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em Azure ou GCP;
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade (Grafana, Prometheus);
  • Experiência com IaC (Terraform, Crossplane);
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Linux, redes e segurança;
  • Perfil colaborativo, com mentalidade de produto e foco em automação.


Diferenciais

  • Certificações adicionais em Kubernetes, Cloud ou DevOps;
  • Experiência com SRE, reliability engineering ou plataformas internas;
  • Vivência em ambientes complexos e distribuídos.

title: Consultor Funcional de Dados - Arquitetura de Modelagem e Governança
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Profissional Funcional de Dados, com forte atuação em arquitetura de modelagem, governança de métricas e contextos, para atuar em um ambiente financeiro de alta criticidade e exigência técnica. A posição requer sólida visão de dados, atenção às regras de negócio e capacidade de estruturar camadas analíticas confiáveis, seguras e governadas.


Resumo da Posição:

O(a) profissional será responsável por estruturar e sustentar a camada semântica e de governança de dados, garantindo consistência de métricas, controle de acessos, padronização das regras de negócio e suporte ao modelo de self-service BI das áreas de negócio. Atuará de forma próxima a times técnicos e gestores com alto nível de exigência, sendo fundamental postura profissional, domínio conceitual e clareza na comunicação.

title: UI/UX Graphic Designer | Remote | Brazil | Full-Time
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right. We’re seeking experienced, creative graphic designers to join our growing team.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.



What We’re Looking For


We’re looking for team players who live and breathe design. People who are creative powerhouses and thrive on pushing boundaries and finding ways to bring fresh ideas to life. Ready to join our team and start designing?


About You


  • You’re super motivated and genuinely passionate about nailing the job every time.
  • You’re a problem-solver, always a few steps ahead and never caught off guard.
  • You bring good vibes to the table—you’re respectful, friendly, and a great collaborator.
  • You’re a time management wizard.
  • You’re a team player
  • Communication is your jam—clear, concise, and always spot-on.
  • You’re resourceful—if you don’t know something, you don’t flinch. You’ve got Google, you’ve got grit, and you always figure it out.
  • Bonus points if you geek out on things like DND, Pokémon, or video games. Our team’s got some serious nerd cred, and we’re looking for like-minded peeps to join!


Qualifications and Skills


  • 2+ years of hands-on design experience—show us your growth and expertise
  • Proficiency in Figma and Webflow. You know the ins and outs of these tools like your favourite video game’s cheat codes
  • Mastery of the Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign—you live and breathe these tools.
  • A killer design portfolio that shows off your best work.
  • Working level of English (enough to communicate your ideas clearly, both in writing and speaking).
  • A bachelor’s degree is a plus.
  • Comfortable with Microsoft Office & Google Workspace (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and their Google equivalents).
  • Comfortable designing for various media—digital, print, and even big formats.
  • Eager to dabble with AI in your workflow, and you’re open to new tech that enhances your creativity.
  • Know your way around social media graphics formatting—you get the vibe.
  • A knack for creating cohesive designs from brand identity guidelines (without breaking a sweat).
  • You can whip up mockups for design presentations like a true pro.


Bonus Points


  • You worship Canva or other online tools like it’s your creative playground.
  • You’re into AI design tools—we think they’re pretty rad, and you should too!



Our operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, submit your resume & portfolio today!

This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
  • Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
  • Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
  • Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Senior DataOps Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.


About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Databricks environment (any cloud)
  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience
  • Strong proficiency in Data Governance processes and tools
  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with DevOps practices


Conditions

  • 100% Remote role , primarily aligned to UTC-5 (EST) with a minimum of 5 hours overlap required
  • Contractor role – 6-month contract, renewable based on budget and performance
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week)
  • BYOD requirement

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Hourly Role | Remote | PST Hours


Chosan is hiring a Virtual Operations Specialist (VOS) to support our fast growing luxury housing and lifestyle platform. This role sits at the center of day to day operations and leasing and is ideal for someone who is organized, responsive, and comfortable handling multiple workflows at once.


Role Overview


The VOS supports both operations and leasing functions across our portfolio. You will be responsible for guest and prospect communication, lease and payment processing, and operational coordination to ensure a smooth experience for residents and internal teams.


This is an hourly paid position with core weekday hours and required weekend availability.


Schedule


Core hours: 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM PST, Monday through Friday

Weekend availability required on a rotating or as needed basis


Key Responsibilities


Respond to guest and prospect inquiries across multiple platforms

Handle and coordinate maintenance requests with vendors and internal teams

Send invoices and follow up on payments

Reconcile payments and flag discrepancies

Process leases, extensions, and related documentation

Respond to leasing and availability inquiries

Support day to day operational workflows and internal coordination

Maintain clear and professional written communication at all times


Requirements


Strong written English and professional communication skills

Highly organized with strong attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast paced environment

Comfortable working with operational tools, CRMs, and property management systems

Reliable internet connection and ability to work PST hours

Availability to work weekends as required


What This Role Is Not


This is not a passive admin role. You will be actively managing live guest issues, payments, and leasing workflows. Responsiveness, accountability, and ownership are critical.


Why Chosan


Chosan is a luxury lifestyle and housing company redefining flexible living. We move fast, operate with high standards, and expect our team to do the same. If you enjoy operations, problem solving, and being at the center of the action, this role is a strong fit.

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei profissional de desenvolvimento, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos #feras com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



- O que você deve ter?


  • Atuação com desenvolvimento Java (versões mais atuais).
  • Experiência com ecossistema SpringBoot .
  • Necessário conhecimento AWS Services (ECS, EC2, EKS, S3, Lambda, Kafka, DynamoDB ou similar, CI/CD, entre outros).
  • Experiência com testes utilizando JUnit, Mockito, entre outros...
  • Familiaridade com estrutura de microsserviços .
  • Desejável conhecimento em ambiente financeiro, PIX e/ou cobrança .



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

  • Familiaridade com estrutura de microsserviços .
  • Desejável conhecimento em ambiente financeiro, PIX e/ou cobrança .



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: DevOps Engineer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


**Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal**


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you'll need to have

  • Proven experience with Azure Databricks or Azure Data Factory.
  • Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes and hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience in creating and maintaining Helm Charts.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Experience with CI/CD (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD).
  • Scripting knowledge in Bash, Python, or equivalent.
  • Experience in monitoring and troubleshooting distributed systems.
  • English proficiency (minimum B2 level).
  • Availability to relocate and live in Portugal with our support;


Also good to have:

  • Experience with Service Mesh (e.g., Istio, Linkerd).
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes and cloud security.
  • Familiarity with full-stack observability.
  • Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD) are valued.


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Autonomy, proactivity, and focus (even under pressure);
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Versatility (you can be a fan of BYOD or not);
  • Ability to innovate and evolve in a market in constant mutation.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a technology focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.


Do you think you're the one we are looking for?

Let’s chat ! Send your application and take a look at :

title: Executive Assistant | Fully Remote | English Speaking
description:
Brazilstrat connects top-tier Brazilian remote talent with organizations abroad. We are currently selecting an Executive Assistant to join a fast-paced, dynamic international scaleup , supporting the CEO and Founder.


In this role, you will work remotely as a strategic partner to leadership. This is an ideal position for a proactive, organized professional looking to work closely with C-level management in a global environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Operational Excellence: efficiently manage complex calendars, international travel logistics, and inbox triage to ensure the CEO’s day-to-day runs smoothly.
  • Strategic Support: act as a partner to the CEO by leading ad-hoc business projects, conducting market research, and preparing briefing materials to support decision-making.
  • Communication & Reporting: prepare high-quality presentations (decks), reports, and meeting minutes for board meetings and internal strategy sessions.
  • Force Multiplier: facilitate cross-functional communication and handle operational roadblocks, allowing leadership to focus on high-impact strategy.


Requirements:

  • Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Tech-savvy: proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and productivity tools like Notion. Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively to increase efficiency is highly valued.
  • Proactive mindset: you are a problem solver who addresses issues before they become emergencies.
  • High emotional intelligence and professional discretion.


What We Offer:

  • 100% remote, home-office flexibility.
  • Direct exposure to C-Level leadership and business operations.
  • Growth opportunities within a rapidly scaling international company.


How to Apply: Please complete our initial screening form here:


Note: Only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como referência técnica no desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções para o setor de telecomunicações.
  • Colaborar na definição da arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar ativamente da sustentação das integrações existentes e evolução de novos produtos.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores plenos e juniores.
  • Apoiar processos de pré-vendas e apresentações técnicas para clientes.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Java (preferência para Java 11+).
  • Proficiência com Spring Boot e ecossistema Spring (Web, Security, Data).
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST, mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ) e microserviços.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).
  • Vivência com Docker, Kubernetes e ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Familiaridade com API Gateways como Kong ou Apigee.
  • Experiência com observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger ou ELK).


Competências Comportamentais:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com diferentes áreas técnicas.
  • Habilidade para gerenciar projetos e atuar em um ambiente de alta complexidade.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação para clientes.
  • Proatividade para identificar e resolver problemas técnicos.
  • Visão sistêmica sobre o desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e resilientes.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Golang.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento front-end (React, Vue ou Angular).
  • Conhecimento de segurança de APIs e práticas de CQRs.
  • Experiência com PL/SQL e tuning de queries.


Você vai amar trabalhar aqui se:

  • Quiser ter a possibilidade de aprender e trabalhar com diversas tecnologias;
  • Estiver em busca de uma empresa com possibilidades reais de crescimento e carreira;
  • Estiver em busca de um ambiente leve e descontraído para trabalhar;


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale refeição;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Vale combustível;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Auxílio crianças com deficiência;
  • Convênio Farmácia;
  • PLR;
  • TotalPass;
  • Integra (Programa Qualidade de Vida);


E mais: Trabalho Híbrido.

  • Apoio a certificações;
  • Day off no mês do seu aniversário;

title: Systems Engineer
description:
Systems Engineer (Fully Remote)


We’re looking for a Systems Engineer to help build, automate, and support development and test environments across a large-scale platform. You’ll play a key role in designing, deploying, and optimising cloud and on-prem environments that support critical applications from build through to production support.


What you’ll do

  • Build and manage development & test environments across on-prem and AWS platforms
  • Automate infrastructure and platform tasks using Python , Ansible , and Flux
  • Deploy and support applications on Kubernetes (including Helm-based deployments)
  • Ensure seamless system integration, reliability, performance, and security
  • Monitor platforms and applications, implementing automated testing and health checks
  • Troubleshoot complex platform and deployment issues
  • Collaborate closely with development and operations teams


What you’ll bring

  • Strong automation and scripting experience with Python
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerised platforms
  • Experience deploying applications using Helm
  • Understanding of JSON and its relationship to YANG
  • Solid grasp of cyber security principles and compliance
  • Foundational networking knowledge
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills


Nice to have

  • Experience with tools/technologies such as Kafka, Elastic stack, Redis, MongoDB, Postgres
  • AWS services including EKS, Lambda, Cognito, API Gateway
  • Network and infrastructure tooling (NetBox, Juniper, Cisco, MinIO)
  • Testing frameworks such as Behave or Robot Framework


Location: Fully Remote

Role type: Contract


If you enjoy building reliable platforms through automation and working across modern cloud and container technologies, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Business Analyst - Workday
description:
Role Summary:

We are seeking a Senior Workday Business Analyst with strong expertise in Workday Business Processes (BPs) and functional integration knowledge . This is a strategic, functional role — not a technical development position — acting as a bridge between HR business teams, IT development, and QA.

The successful candidate will play a central role in translating business needs into clear process and integration requirements, ensuring alignment between Workday Business Processes and downstream integrations, and coordinating testing cycles to deliver high-quality solutions in a global Workday environment.


Key Responsibilities:

Serve as a functional expert in Workday Business Processes , understanding end-to-end process flows.

Write and maintain Business and System Requirements for new integrations and process enhancements.

Act as liaison between business stakeholders, developers, and QA teams .

Translate business requirements into functional specifications aligned with Workday configuration and integration frameworks.

Review current business processes, identify improvement opportunities, and recommend best practices.

Coordinate and support test planning, execution, and user acceptance testing (UAT) .

Perform functional validation of integrations, execute basic tests, and identify and report defects.

Refine requirements based on technical feedback and test outcomes.

Support project planning activities including estimates, schedules, and documentation in partnership with IT and project managers.


Business Process Expertise (Critical):

Deep understanding of how Workday Business Processes operate end-to-end.

Strong awareness that integration logic is driven by BP design .

Priority Business Processes include:

o Hire

o Termination

o Job Change

o Benefits & Life Events

Full mastery of all Workday BPs is not required — strong knowledge of approximately 25–50 core BPs is sufficient.

Ability to apply BP frameworks consistently across different functional areas.


Integrations (Functional Level):

Understand Workday’s integration framework and architecture .

Ability to open, review, and validate integrations against business requirements.

Execute basic functional integration testing.

Identify simple errors and communicate issues effectively to technical teams.

Write Business Requirements for new integrations .

No development or coding of integrations is expected.


Testing & Quality Assurance:

Partner closely with SDM and QA teams.

Contribute to test strategy, test plans, and test scripts .

Coordinate test cycles and track results through resolution.

Adjust requirements based on validation outcomes.

Support production deployment and post-go-live stabilization.


Stakeholder Interaction:

80% interaction with Senior HR Managers across functional workstreams (Benefits, HR Operations, etc.).

20% interaction with VP-level stakeholders on escalations and high-visibility initiatives.

This role is not heavily political; strong process mastery enables confident stakeholder engagement.

Direct leadership support is available for executive-level presentations when needed.


Immediate Focus (First Months):

Produce Business Requirements for new integrations.

Act as the central connector between business users, developers, and QA.

Refine requirements based on technical feedback.

Coordinate and oversee testing cycles.


Tools & Technical Environment:

Workday (required)

Workday Prism / X10 (nice-to-have, not mandatory)

Flexibility to learn additional tools on the job.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Strong experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, and process documentation .

Solid understanding of SDLC methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to interpret data, identify issues, and recommend solutions.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities.

Ability to act as a key liaison between business operations and IT teams.

Experience working with senior-level business and technology stakeholders.


Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business, or related field — or equivalent experience.

5+ years of Workday HCM experience , preferably across Core HR, Benefits, Compensation, Recruiting, Payroll, or Talent modules.

Global Workday implementation experience preferred.

Experience in enterprise-scale or financial services environments is a plus.



Why build your carrer at Meta?

We offer autonomy, clear goals and a dynamic and challenging environment, where professionals have the opportunity to interact with different technologies, participate in all types of projects, bring new ideas and work from anywhere in Brazil and (why not?) anywhere in the world. In addition, we are one of the best companies to work for in Brazil according to Great Place to Work and one of the 10 fastest growing technology companies in the country for 3 consecutive years, according to Anuário Informático Hoje.


What are our values?

- We are people serving people

- We all think and act like owners

- We are hungry for performance

- We grow and learn together

- We pursue excellence and simplicity

- We have innovation and creativity in our DNA

All people are welcome regardless of their condition, disability, ethnicity, religious belief, sexual orientation, appearance, age or others. We want you to grow up with us in a welcoming environment full of opportunities.

Did you relate? Then, #ComeBeMeta!

title: Business Analyst - Workday
description:
Role Summary:

We are seeking a Senior Workday Business Analyst with strong expertise in Workday Business Processes (BPs) and functional integration knowledge . This is a strategic, functional role — not a technical development position — acting as a bridge between HR business teams, IT development, and QA.

The successful candidate will play a central role in translating business needs into clear process and integration requirements, ensuring alignment between Workday Business Processes and downstream integrations, and coordinating testing cycles to deliver high-quality solutions in a global Workday environment.


Key Responsibilities:

Serve as a functional expert in Workday Business Processes , understanding end-to-end process flows.

Write and maintain Business and System Requirements for new integrations and process enhancements.

Act as liaison between business stakeholders, developers, and QA teams .

Translate business requirements into functional specifications aligned with Workday configuration and integration frameworks.

Review current business processes, identify improvement opportunities, and recommend best practices.

Coordinate and support test planning, execution, and user acceptance testing (UAT) .

Perform functional validation of integrations, execute basic tests, and identify and report defects.

Refine requirements based on technical feedback and test outcomes.

Support project planning activities including estimates, schedules, and documentation in partnership with IT and project managers.


Business Process Expertise (Critical):

Deep understanding of how Workday Business Processes operate end-to-end.

Strong awareness that integration logic is driven by BP design .

Priority Business Processes include:

o Hire

o Termination

o Job Change

o Benefits & Life Events

Full mastery of all Workday BPs is not required — strong knowledge of approximately 25–50 core BPs is sufficient.

Ability to apply BP frameworks consistently across different functional areas.


Integrations (Functional Level):

Understand Workday’s integration framework and architecture .

Ability to open, review, and validate integrations against business requirements.

Execute basic functional integration testing.

Identify simple errors and communicate issues effectively to technical teams.

Write Business Requirements for new integrations .

No development or coding of integrations is expected.


Testing & Quality Assurance:

Partner closely with SDM and QA teams.

Contribute to test strategy, test plans, and test scripts .

Coordinate test cycles and track results through resolution.

Adjust requirements based on validation outcomes.

Support production deployment and post-go-live stabilization.


Stakeholder Interaction:

80% interaction with Senior HR Managers across functional workstreams (Benefits, HR Operations, etc.).

20% interaction with VP-level stakeholders on escalations and high-visibility initiatives.

This role is not heavily political; strong process mastery enables confident stakeholder engagement.

Direct leadership support is available for executive-level presentations when needed.


Immediate Focus (First Months):

Produce Business Requirements for new integrations.

Act as the central connector between business users, developers, and QA.

Refine requirements based on technical feedback.

Coordinate and oversee testing cycles.


Tools & Technical Environment:

Workday (required)

Workday Prism / X10 (nice-to-have, not mandatory)

Flexibility to learn additional tools on the job.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Strong experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, and process documentation .

Solid understanding of SDLC methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to interpret data, identify issues, and recommend solutions.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities.

Ability to act as a key liaison between business operations and IT teams.

Experience working with senior-level business and technology stakeholders.


Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business, or related field — or equivalent experience.

5+ years of Workday HCM experience , preferably across Core HR, Benefits, Compensation, Recruiting, Payroll, or Talent modules.

Global Workday implementation experience preferred.

Experience in enterprise-scale or financial services environments is a plus.

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Location: San Francisco, CA - Remote (LATAM preferred)

Work Type: Full-Time


We’re partnering with a confidential, high-growth technology company in Silicon Valley that’s building AI-powered platforms. This team moves fast, cares about craftsmanship, and empowers engineers to own meaningful work for the long term.


This is a full-time, remote opportunity to join a global-first product team tackling complex problems with modern tech and a culture that values quality and speed.


✅ What You’ll Do

- Design, build, and maintain features across the stack.

- Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering peers to ship high-quality work.

- Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code.

- Contribute to architecture decisions, technical planning, and code reviews.

- Help shape team workflows, best practices, and developer experience.


What You Bring

- 5+ years of professional experience in software development as a Full Stack Developer.

- 2+ years of professional experience as an AI/ML Engineer.

- Proficiency with Python, React, Express, MongoDB, Node or equivalent .

- Strong understanding of APIs, performance, scalability, etc..

- Clear, proactive communication and comfort working on distributed, async teams.

- A product mindset and strong sense of ownership.

- Startup or high-growth team background

- Proficiency in English

- Passion for building scalable systems and great user experiences.


What You’ll Get

- Competitive compensation in USD.

- 100% remote with flexible hours.

- Long-term, product-focused work with clear ownership.

- A smart, collaborative, globally distributed team.


If you’re excited to work with a fast-moving team building the future of AI at scale — let’s connect.

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Analista PL / Consultor SAP Basis



Responsabilidades:


1. Fornecer suporte técnico avançado, aderindo aos padrões de qualidade e requisitos regulamentares, garantindo a conformidade com as políticas da empresa nos ambientes SAP Basis e SAP HANA DB.

2. Resolver incidentes complexos escalados por analistas, realizando análises de causa raiz completas e implementando soluções eficazes para resolver problemas técnicos e de segurança.

3. Facilitar a transferência de conhecimento, atualizando e gerenciando a base de conhecimento, treinando novos membros da equipe e orientando analistas para aprimorar as capacidades da equipe.

4. Gerenciar e resolver chamados complexos dentro dos SLAs acordados, colaborando com equipes de suporte multifuncionais para manter a eficiência operacional e garantir uma postura de segurança robusta.

5. Aprimorar a experiência do cliente, alcançando altas taxas de resolução no primeiro contato, minimizando resoluções rejeitadas e reaberturas de casos, enquanto mitiga proativamente as ameaças à segurança.


Requisitos:

  • Inglês avançado. - boa comunicação, participação em chamadas, etc. (OBRIGATÓRIO)
  • Sólido conhecimento do pacote de soluções SAP e arquitetura técnica, com capacidade de traduzir desafios de negócios.
  • 4. Fortes habilidades de consultoria e gestão de stakeholders – habilidades demonstráveis de apresentação, consultoria voltada para o cliente e influência até o nível executivo (C-suite). Todos os candidatos devem ser assertivos e articulados, com capacidade de desenvolver e manter relacionamentos com clientes de alto nível.
  • 5. Compreensão da estratégia de produto da SAP, incluindo o posicionamento do S/4HANA e ferramentas de habilitação e tecnologias complementares, especialmente a integração com outros aplicativos.
  • 6. Bom conhecimento das ofertas de nuvem pública GCP, AWS e Azure e arquitetura de soluções.

title: Analista/Arquiteto de Cloud
description:
Descrição da Vaga:


Buscamos profissional para atuar na administração, monitoramento e otimização de ambientes em nuvem, garantindo alta disponibilidade, segurança e desempenho dos sistemas. O candidato apoiará times de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura, implementando soluções escaláveis e eficientes em AWS, Azure ou GCP.


Requisitos:


• Mínimo 3 anos de experiência em ambientes de Cloud.

• Certificação AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.

• Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Conhecimentos técnicos:


• Cloud: AWS, Azure ou GCP

• Sistemas Operacionais: Windows Server / Linux

• Serviços de rede: DNS, VPN, Firewalls, Proxy, Load Balancers

• Serviços de servidor: File Server (Windows / NFS / Samba), Mail Server (Exchange / Postfix / Zimbra), Web Server (IIS / Apache / Nginx)

• Virtualização: VMWare, Hyper-V, XenServer

• Monitoramento e Backup: Nagios, Zabbix, MRTG

• Automação e scripting: Bash / PowerShell

• Especialidade: Troubleshooting de infra e sistemas operacionais


Diferenciais:

• Experiência em ambientes híbridos ou multicloud


Localização:

• Home office, São Paulo – SP

title: Especialista de Projetos
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Executar os projetos da área garantindo o adequado levantamento de requisitos de demandas, classificação, planejamento e controle a fim de executar a entrega das mesmas de acordo com as definições de segurança.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Liderança e Execução: Gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de projetos, desde a iniciação e planejamento até a execução, monitoramento, controle e encerramento.
  • Planejamento: Elaborar cronogramas detalhados, definir escopo, identificar riscos e planejar recursos (equipe, orçamento, materiais).
  • Comunicação: Atuar como o principal ponto de contato, garantindo a comunicação fluida entre stakeholders, equipes técnicas e áreas de negócio.
  • Monitoramento: Realizar o acompanhamento do progresso dos projetos, identificar desvios e implementar ações corretivas (turn-around).
  • Gestão de Mudanças: Gerenciar solicitações de mudança de escopo, avaliando seu impacto e garantindo a aprovação e documentação adequadas.
  • Metodologia: Aplicar as melhores práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (tradicionais, ágeis ou híbridas), mantendo a documentação e artefatos de projeto atualizados.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Contribuir para a evolução dos processos e ferramentas de Gestão de Projetos da empresa.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Formação superior completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Administração, Engenharia, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida (mínimo de 7 anos) na gestão de projetos de TI e/ou Negócios.
  • Conhecimento avançado em metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos (ex: PMI/PMBOK, Scrum, Kanban).
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e resolução de conflitos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ambientes de ritmo acelerado.
  • Experiência comprovada ou conhecimento no ERP TOTVS Protheus.(Técnico ou Projetos)
  • Certificação PMP, CSM, ou equivalente.
  • Experiência em projetos de implantação, migração ou otimização de sistemas ERP (especialmente Protheus).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ex: MS Project, Jira, Trello, Asana).


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

English fluently

Agile projets

Project Management

Agile Ways of Working, Scrum, SAFe knowledge. Hands on Jira/ADO

SAFe

Jira

Scrum

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Childcare assistance

Gympass

Reimbursement of Certifications

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform
